Method of Attack: Attacker requires Administrative access to exploit vulnerabilities in AMD Secure Processor (PSP) firmware; MasterKey involves corrupting PSP firmware flash undetected; RyzenFall and Fallout involve writing to PSP registers exploiting interface vulnerabilities between x86 and PSP
Attack Vector: Requires Administrative access on compromised system
Method of Mitigation: Firmware patch release through BIOS update planned; no performance impact expected
